bit_encoding: framed bytes MSB-first; bit d -> cell hilbert_d2xy(order=6, d); cell filled=1 (ink 0x00), empty=0 (background 0xFF)
framing: b"GLY1" + >H payload length + payload + zero pad to 4096 bits
mask_wire: RLE pairs 'run,bit' comma-separated, row-major over the 64x64 cell grid
notes: unseen stylized input; promptable point + nonzero box origin; wire score is the measured Otsu eta of the frame crop
